items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He had Reuben Wrighty with him for a while too. [INTERVIEWEE] Reuben played with him, yeah.

ctx.x: And he's had Paul Barnes with him. That's what Paul was with him. He had Reuben Wrighty with him for a while too.
What kind of a trumpet player was he in the early days, in the twenties?
